item.tib: ming tshig ge sar rgyan gyi 'phreng ba
item.coloph: de ltar blo gsal ba'i mchog rnams la brjod pa'i ming tshig ge sar rgyan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ sho lo drug bcus 'thus pa byas te/ blang dor gyi gnad rnams gsal bar byed pa dang / rang blo gros te brjod bya mthar thugs pa'i tshig gi gcer mthong / dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis/ gnyan khrod tsha lung chu tshan khar brtsams pa dge legs 'phel//
